name: User Avatars
description: Local avatar uploads and Gravatar management for WordPress users.

settings.label: Enable local avatars
settings.description: Allow users to upload local avatar images instead of using Gravatar.

settings.label: Disable Gravatar
settings.description: Disable Gravatar integration completely. When enabled, all Gravatar functionality will be removed.

settings.label: Allowed file types
settings.description: Image file types that can be uploaded for local avatars.

settings.label: Max file size (KB)
settings.description: Maximum upload size for avatars in KB. Recommended: 2048 KB (2 MB).
